_about: RELM in, IRELM out. table defaults to example_table.yaml. options are the relm CLI flags (stateless, strict, locale). A case has output or error (an error kind). A case with inputs and outputs runs several replies through one converter, so MESSAGE ids carry on from reply to reply.

cases.name: doc example, stack
cases.output: <IRELM><VAD v="4" a="4" d="3"> She asked me to buy <MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="widen(0.8)" id="1"/><PROSODY s="0.6" v="1.5" p="0.75">roses</PROSODY><MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="widen(None)" id="1" close="true"/></VAD></IRELM>

cases.name: doc example, stateless
cases.output: <VAD v="4" a="4" d="3"/> She asked me to buy <MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="widen(0.8)" id="1"/><PROSODY p="0.75" s="0.6" r="none" v="1.5"/>roses<PROSODY p="none" s="none" r="none" v="none"/><MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="widen(None)" id="1" close="true"/><VAD v="none" a="none" d="none"/>

cases.name: lottery, stateless resolves none to the enclosing value
cases.input: <happy> I won <ecstatic>the lottery</ecstatic> but lost the ticket </happy>
cases.output: <VAD v="4" a="4" d="3"/> I won <VAD v="4" a="5" d="5"/>the lottery<VAD v="4" a="4" d="3"/> but lost the ticket <VAD v="none" a="none" d="none"/>

cases.name: lottery, stack
cases.input: <happy> I won <ecstatic>the lottery</ecstatic> but lost the ticket </happy>
cases.output: <IRELM><VAD v="4" a="4" d="3"> I won <VAD a="5" d="5">the lottery</VAD> but lost the ticket </VAD></IRELM>

cases.name: plain text only
cases.output: <IRELM>Hello there.</IRELM>

cases.name: empty
cases.output: <IRELM></IRELM>

cases.name: instant macros, open, self-closed or with a stray close
cases.output: <IRELM>a<PAUSE duration="0.5"/>b<PAUSE duration="0.5"/>cd<MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="wink(right)"/><PAUSE duration="0.2"/>e</IRELM>

cases.name: self-closed span macro opens and closes at once
cases.output: <IRELM><MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="widen(0.8)" id="1"/><MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="widen(None)" id="1" close="true"/>look<VAD v="4" a="4" d="3"></VAD></IRELM>

cases.name: macro with two spans closes them in reverse
cases.output: <IRELM><VAD a="5"><PROSODY s="1.2" p="1.1">wow</PROSODY></VAD></IRELM>

cases.name: macro with two spans, stateless
cases.output: <VAD v="4" a="4" d="3"/><VAD v="4" a="5" d="3"/><PROSODY p="1.1" s="1.2" r="none" v="none"/>wow<PROSODY p="none" s="none" r="none" v="none"/><VAD v="4" a="4" d="3"/><VAD v="none" a="none" d="none"/>

cases.name: explicit none in the table keeps the enclosing value
cases.output: <PROSODY p="0.75" s="0.6" r="none" v="1.5"/><PROSODY p="0.75" s="0.6" r="none" v="0.5"/>psst<PROSODY p="0.75" s="0.6" r="none" v="1.5"/><PROSODY p="none" s="none" r="none" v="none"/>

cases.name: same macro nested
cases.output: <IRELM><VAD v="4" a="4" d="3">a<VAD v="4" a="4" d="3">b</VAD>c</VAD></IRELM>

cases.name: voice span, stateless
cases.output: <VOICE voice="cmu-bdl-hsmm" locale="en_US"/>arr<VOICE voice="none" locale="none"/>

cases.name: beep and audio
cases.output: <IRELM><BEEP melody="C4,0.1; E4,0.1; G4,0.1; C5,0.2; R,0.1; Eb5,0.2"/>ta da<AUDIO file_name="ding.wav"/></IRELM>

cases.name: text is escaped, entities are decoded first
cases.output: <IRELM>3 < 5 & 6 > 2, Tom & Jerry, <not a tag>, AB, &nbsp;</IRELM>

cases.name: best effort: unknown tags are dropped, their text kept
cases.output: <IRELM>q bold</IRELM>

cases.name: strict: unknown tag
best effort: closing an outer macro closes the inner ones
cases.output: <IRELM><VAD v="4" a="4" d="3">x<PROSODY s="0.6" v="1.5" p="0.75">y</PROSODY></VAD>z</IRELM>

cases.name: strict: mismatched close
best effort: unclosed macros close at the end
cases.output: <IRELM><VAD v="4" a="4" d="3">x<PROSODY s="0.6" v="1.5" p="0.75">y</PROSODY></VAD></IRELM>

cases.name: strict: unclosed
best effort: stray close is ignored
cases.output: <IRELM>ab</IRELM>

cases.name: strict: stray close
best effort: malformed tag is kept as text
cases.output: <IRELM>a <happy b</IRELM>

cases.name: strict: malformed tag
a lone < that does not start a tag is text, even when strict
cases.output: <IRELM>I <3 you, 1 < 2</IRELM>

cases.name: best effort: params on a macro are ignored
cases.output: <IRELM><VAD v="4" a="4" d="3">x</VAD></IRELM>

cases.name: strict: params on a macro
best effort: macro names match case-insensitively
cases.output: <IRELM><VAD v="4" a="4" d="3">x</VAD></IRELM>

cases.name: strict: macro names are case-sensitive
tags may have whitespace inside
cases.output: <IRELM><VAD v="4" a="4" d="3">x</VAD><MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="wink(right)"/><PAUSE duration="0.2"/></IRELM>

cases.name: AS is expanded and keeps the surrounding whitespace
cases.output: <IRELM>Meet at two thirty p m on the sixteenth of October twenty twenty six.</IRELM>

cases.name: AS uses the locale option
cases.output: <IRELM>October sixteenth twenty twenty six one thousand two hundred thirty four</IRELM>

cases.name: AS locale param beats the locale option
cases.output: <IRELM>October sixteenth twenty twenty six</IRELM>

cases.name: AS inside other macros
cases.output: <IRELM><VAD v="4" a="4" d="3">It costs twelve dollars fifty cents</VAD></IRELM>

cases.name: best effort: unreadable AS text is left as it is
cases.output: <IRELM>soon</IRELM>

cases.name: strict: unreadable AS text
AS is never sent in stateless mode
cases.output: S H E fifteen seconds

cases.name: inline table with long param names
cases.table_yaml:
calm: <VAD valence="3.5" arousal="2">
slow: <PROSODY speed="0.8" pitch="none">
cases.output: <IRELM><VAD v="3.5" a="2"><PROSODY s="0.8" p="none">easy</PROSODY></VAD></IRELM>

cases.name: attribute values are escaped on output
cases.output: <IRELM><MESSAGE sub="log" action="print("a & b")"/></IRELM>

cases.name: ids pair opens and closes by position
cases.output: <IRELM><MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="widen(0.8)" id="1"/><MESSAGE sub="head" action="tilt(0.3)" id="2"/>oh<MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="widen(None)" id="1" close="true"/><MESSAGE sub="head" action="tilt(None)" id="2" close="true"/></IRELM>

cases.name: ids carry on across replies
outputs: <IRELM><MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="widen(0.8)" id="1"/>a<MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="widen(None)" id="1" close="true"/></IRELM>

<IRELM><MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="widen(0.8)" id="2"/>b<MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="widen(None)" id="2" close="true"/><MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="widen(0.8)" id="3"/>c<MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="widen(None)" id="3" close="true"/></IRELM>

cases.name: nested opens of one macro get their own ids
cases.output: <IRELM><MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="widen(0.8)" id="1"/>a<MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="widen(0.8)" id="2"/>b<MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="widen(None)" id="2" close="true"/>c<MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="widen(None)" id="1" close="true"/></IRELM>

cases.name: unclosed macro closes at the end with its id
cases.output: <IRELM><VAD v="4" a="4" d="3"><MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="widen(0.8)" id="1"/>a<MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="widen(None)" id="1" close="true"/></VAD></IRELM>

cases.name: ids in stateless mode
cases.output: <MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="widen(0.8)" id="1"/><MESSAGE sub="head" action="tilt(0.3)" id="2"/>oh<MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="widen(None)" id="1" close="true"/><MESSAGE sub="head" action="tilt(None)" id="2" close="true"/>

cases.name: messages in a macro with no /name get no id
cases.output: <IRELM><VAD v="4"><MESSAGE sub="head" action="nod()"/>yay</VAD><MESSAGE sub="eyes" action="wink(right)"/><PAUSE duration="0.2"/></IRELM>

cases.name: stateless plain text has no wrapper
cases.output: Hello there.
